name: contradiction_vs_consistency_mini_eval
description: Held-out balanced mini ASNE contrast for matching versus differing scene information.

items.text: A person reads a gate number on a ticket and sees that number shown on the overhead display.
Someone checks a shelf tag and sees the item code match the code on the package.
A person reads a gate number on a ticket while the overhead display shows another number.
Someone checks a shelf tag and sees the item code differ from the code on the package.
